title: prefill: chunked + speculative prefill with stage overlap and scheduler/kernel improvements
author: Ava Martinez
commits: b2c9e7f: speculative prefill path + heuristics for early decode start
c3d8f12: stage overlap runtime plumbing and scheduler hooks
d4e6a21: KV-cache prefetch + cache invalidation fixes
e5f7b33: kernel selection guardrails for chunked execution
f6a8c44: perf canary harness and microbench tests
description:
Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency and improve GPU utilization for mixed prefill/decode workloads by combining chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage overlap. This change implements a chunked prefill execution path that breaks large prefill sequences into smaller prefetched chunks, a speculative prefill heuristic to begin decode work sooner when safe, and stage-overlap plumbing so prefill and decode stages can overlap on independent resources. Additionally we add scheduler hooks and kernel-selection adjustments to favor lower-latency kernels for short-chunk execution and improve KV-cache prefetching to avoid stalls. The PR includes: - chunked prefill runtime components and config flags - speculative prefill heuristic with safety checks (token boundaries, cache warmness) - stage overlap orchestration (pipeline stage markers, resource reservations) - scheduler changes to expose per-request preferred execution windows and preemption hints - kernel selection tweaks to pick FIFO-friendly kernels for chunked runs - KV-cache prefetch + TTL/invalidation fix and metrics - perf canary integration and microbench harnesses

Checklist:
- [x] Chunked prefill execution implemented and feature-flagged
- [x] Speculative prefill heuristic with unit tests
- [x] Stage overlap orchestration + integration tests
- [x] Scheduler hooks added and documented in runtime API
- [x] Kernel selection tests and fallbacks added
- [x] KV-cache fixes and metrics
- [x] Benchmarks and perf-canary results attached

Performance summary: microbenchmarks and canary runs on p4d-like machines show median latency improved by ~12-18% for long-prefill workloads and 18-28% tail (p95/p99) reduction for mixed prefill+decode traffic. End-to-end throughput for batched mixed workloads improved up to ~25% depending on request distribution. CPU and GPU utilization graphs attached in perf canary result notes. Safety: speculative prefill is gated behind feature flags and conservative heuristics; we fall back to non-speculative prefill on mismatches. Backwards compatibility: no API changes; behavior behind flags. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind runtime flags + perf-canary monitoring, enable for select Dedicated pools first. References: ENG-2910 (prefill redesign), ENG-3087 (scheduler hooks), related PRs pr-33500, pr-32758.

Liam O'Connor: CI perf-canary shows 22% throughput improvement on canary cluster, approving.

release_notes: Improves prefill/decode latency and throughput by introducing chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage overlap. Feature-flagged and rollout controlled. See runtime docs for configuration.
